name: line_of_sight
title: Line of sight
description: Is there a clear radio path between two nodes? Pick the two ends, the antenna heights and the frequency: it draws the ground along the path (with the earth's curve), the line between the antennas and the Fresnel zone, and says clear, weaker signal, or blocked at X km. Elevation data from Open-Meteo (free, no key). Never transmits.
